approved_conditional_revision.note: Explicit user-confirmed change; old observable tasks below remain unavailable under their original semantics. No independent validation or training completed.

prediction_target_binding.prediction_unit: Observed patch and its kNN neighbor
prediction_target_binding.evidence: GeometryStructureEncoder.forward gathers patch neighbors; loss shape checks do not verify patch-to-channel membership
prediction_target_binding.required_before_training: Loss-side evidence binds both patch indices to supported channel portions per attribute; ambiguity stays unknown

population.split: C01-C06 fit only; not independent validation

tasks.name: surface_geometry_reconstruction
tasks.definition: Observed patch relative center, normal relation and support extent
tasks.unknown: Degenerate normals; absent support; all ray relation evidence remains UNKNOWN
tasks.forbidden_claim: Predicting geometry already provided as an input proves channel structure learning

tasks.name: construction_operand_affinity
tasks.definition: Same pinned construction operand among pure single-source return patches
tasks.unknown: Mixed patches, missing or multi-source returns
tasks.forbidden_claim: Same operand means same channel/junction; different operand means no connection

tasks.name: observed_channel_axis_relation
tasks.definition: Unsigned axis alignment abs(dot(axis_i, axis_j)) between two locally supported channel portions
tasks.source: Construction axis restricted to independently bound observed local channel support; section directions retain partial-reference status until bound
tasks.unknown: One wall cannot identify a channel axis; ambiguous source/arc or missing joint support
tasks.metric: Absolute alignment error and angular error on qualified targets; coverage separately
tasks.forbidden_claim: Patch-normal angle or global endpoint attachment is a channel-axis label

tasks.name: observed_channel_height_relation
tasks.definition: Signed local channel reference-height difference, neighbor minus receiver, in current sensor coordinates
tasks.source: Same independently supported channel portions as axis relation, not arbitrary wall patch centers
tasks.unknown: No unique support layer, single-wall context, missing or ambiguous local channel correspondence
tasks.metric: MAE in meters over known targets with per-parent counts

tasks.name: observed_section_change
tasks.definition: Log width and height ratios of two observed corresponding local sections, neighbor over receiver
tasks.source: Existing local_section_evidence and contour_surface_support with actual contour support
tasks.unknown: Incomplete contours, unknown width/height, inconsistent section orientation
tasks.metric: Per-dimension known-target error and coverage; never substitute fixed dimensions

tasks.name: local_observed_correspondence
tasks.definition: Two observation-supported local regions refer to the same visible channel portion, not global place identity
tasks.source: Explicit local support correspondence with independently verified alignment and negative evidence
tasks.unknown: Ambiguous alignment, insufficient overlap, repeated geometry without distinguishing evidence
tasks.metric: Both class recalls, precision, unknown coverage, per-parent counts
tasks.forbidden_claim: Source identity, adjacency or free-component equality alone supplies positives/negatives

tasks.name: cross_observation_consistency
tasks.definition: Feature consistency only for independently matched common-visible regions; no global identity negatives
tasks.source: Separate causal windows with source frame rows and verified common support
tasks.unknown: No matched common support; common five-frame context does not establish earlier-time causality
tasks.metric: Matched consistency, token variance/covariance and correspondence quality; no false revisit claim

next_data_operation.scope: Same12 saved partial support; boundary and interior full-contour checks completed, no repeat
